table.name: Cartoon
table.purpose: Episode list for the animated TV series 'Batman: The Brave and the Bold' (season 1, episodes 1-12): each row is one episode with its title, production code, writer, director, original air date, and airing channel. The TV_series table links per-episode ratings and viewership to these rows via id.

Channel.name: Channel
Channel.description: Foreign key to TV_Channel.id identifying the channel that aired the episode. Values are channel ids (700-728); the joined lookup shows these map to channel content labels (e.g. 701, 704, 707 -> 'music'), suggesting the channel table describes channel type/content rather than a specific broadcaster, so the exact channel identity is unresolved.

Directed_by.name: Directed_by
Directed_by.description: Name of the episode's director (Ben Jones, Brandon Vietti, Michael Chang — all directors of the animated series 'Batman: The Brave and the Bold').

Original_air_date.name: Original_air_date
Original_air_date.description: Original US air date of the episode, stored as text like 'December 12, 2008' (spaces stripped). Dates span Nov 2008 – Feb 2009, matching the show's first season.

Production_code.name: Production_code
Production_code.description: Episode production code (101-112), sequential within season 1; 1xx = season 1, episode number.

Title.name: Title
Title.description: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Day of the Dark Knight!', 'Fall of the Blue Beetle!'), all from 'Batman: The Brave and the Bold'.

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; sequential row identifier 1-12, one per episode. Referenced by TV_series (Share, Rating, Viewers_m), which appear to hold per-episode ratings/viewership data.

table.name: TV_Channel
table.purpose: A catalog of music TV channels (mostly Italian Sky/MTV music channels) with their broadcast attributes: country, language, HD availability, pay-TV package, pay-per-view flag, and pixel aspect ratio. Each channel is referenced by the Cartoon and TV_series tables via their Channel columns. The 'series_name' column actually holds the channel name, suggesting the table may have been derived from a TV-series dataset where each channel is represented by a flagship series name; the channel-name reading is strongly supported by the values (Sky Music, MTV Hits, Rock TV).

Content.name: Content
Content.description: Type of programming broadcast by the channel; all rows are 'music', so this table catalogs music TV channels.

Country.name: Country
Country.description: Country of origin/broadcast of the channel (Italy, United Kingdom, Poland).

Hight_definition_TV.name: Hight_definition_TV
Hight_definition_TV.description: Whether the channel broadcasts in high definition; 'yes'/'no' stored as text (misspelled 'Hight').

Language.name: Language
Language.description: Primary broadcast language of the channel (Italian or English).

Package_Option.name: Package_Option
Package_Option.description: Pay-TV subscription package in which the channel is offered (e.g. Sky Famiglia, Sky Famiglia + Sky HD) or 'no ( FTV )' meaning free-to-view with no package.

Pay_per_view_PPV.name: Pay_per_view_PPV
Pay_per_view_PPV.description: Whether the channel is pay-per-view; all rows are 'no', stored as text.

Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR.name: Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR
Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR.description: Pixel aspect ratio of the broadcast video signal (4:3, 16:9, or both).

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; channel number/identifier (numeric, 700–728). Referenced by Cartoon.Channel and TV_series.Channel.

series_name.name: series_name
series_name.description: Name of the TV channel (e.g. Sky Music, MTV Hits, Rock TV); unique per row despite the 'series_name' label.

table.name: TV_series
table.purpose: Per-episode Nielsen ratings data for a 2007 US television series (episode titles match the NBC drama 'Journeyman'): each row is one episode with its air date, channel, household rating/share, 18–49 rating/share, viewers in millions, and weekly rank.

18_49_Rating_Share.name: 18_49_Rating_Share
18_49_Rating_Share.description: Adults 18–49 demographic rating and share for the episode, written as 'rating/share' (e.g. '3.2/8' means a 3.2 rating and an 8% share of viewers watching TV at that time).

Air_Date.name: Air_Date
Air_Date.description: Original broadcast date of the episode, stored as a formatted US date string ('Month Day, Year'); all values fall in October–December 2007, matching a weekly Monday-night schedule.

Channel.name: Channel
Channel.description: Foreign key to TV_Channel.id, selecting the channel/network the episode aired on. Values are numeric channel identifiers (700–728); the lookup table labels these as 'music' content, which conflicts with a TV drama series, so the exact channel meaning is uncertain.

Episode.name: Episode
Episode.description: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Friendly Skies', 'Blowback', 'The Legend of Dylan McCleen'). The titles correspond to episodes of the 2007 NBC series 'Journeyman', supporting that this table documents that show's first-season episodes.

Rating.name: Rating
Rating.description: Nielsen household rating of the episode (percentage of all TV households watching), ranging 3.0–5.8. The detected join to Cartoon.id is a statistical coincidence (small numeric ranges) and should be ignored.

Share.name: Share
Share.description: Nielsen share of the episode: percentage of households watching TV at broadcast time that were watching this show (5–9%). The join to Cartoon.id is spurious.

Viewers_m.name: Viewers_m
Viewers_m.description: Number of viewers in millions (4.24–9.16). The one-to-one join to Cartoon.id is a coincidental artifact of unique numeric values, not a real relationship.

Weekly_Rank.name: Weekly_Rank
Weekly_Rank.description: The episode's rank among all network primetime programs for its broadcast week (43–80, lower is better).

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; sequential row identifier 1–12, one per episode.
